items.label: VFX supervisor briefed on day's shot list and any overnight changes
Chrome ball / grey ball / color chart on hand for lighting reference
Tracking markers and clean-plate needs communicated to 1st AD/camera
HDRI captured at each hero camera position/setup
Bracket sequence covers full dynamic range (no clipped highlights)
Chrome ball + grey ball shot alongside HDRI for lighting/exposure reference
HDRI position measured/logged relative to set geometry
Photogrammetry captured for key set pieces / hero props
LiDAR scan completed for environments requiring CG extension
Set survey/measurements logged (dimensions, camera heights, lens heights)
Greenscreen/bluescreen evenly lit, checked for spill and shadows
Clean plates captured for every greenscreen/LED setup
LED volume content/tracking verified in-camera before rolling (ICVFX)
Reference stills taken of screen/volume state for matchback
Tracking markers placed and logged for matchmove-critical shots
Wide reference stills taken of set dressing/geometry for every setup
Lens grid/distortion charts shot per lens used that day
Camera media offloaded with checksum verification, redundant copies made
On-set LUT applied consistently for dailies/video village monitoring
Metadata (lens, camera, take notes) logged and attached to clips
Dailies QC pass done before wrap (no dropped frames, audio sync, focus issues)
VFX supervisor's daily notes/report completed (shots, issues, decisions)
Any coverage gaps or missed captures flagged to production immediately
Data handed off to DIT/post pipeline confirmed received end of day
